summary: The Cambridge Public Schools rely heavily on E-Rate funding to support internet access, network infrastructure, and managed Wi-Fi across the district. Any reduction would directly impact both operational capacity and educational opportunities, particularly for vulnerable populations. From 2021 to 2025, the district received $825,000 in E-Rate support to help update core infrastructure. In the era of increasing cyber risks, E-rate needs to be expanded to cover basic cybersecurity costs.
